tasks.title: Add deterministic workflow and streamed model hashing

signature_changes.note: Adds the closed set of model-directory categories supported by provenance collection.
Adds the manifest-facing model file descriptor.
Adds the deterministic model hash result shape.
Adds per-file progress events without changing an existing consumer.
Adds deterministic JSON canonical serialization.
Adds canonical workflow SHA-256 hashing.
Adds safe model-root path resolution shared with preflight.
Adds streaming large-file SHA-256 hashing.
Adds sequential deterministic model hash collection.

invariants.name: canonical object equivalence
invariants.description: Whitespace and object-key ordering do not affect canonical workflow identity.
invariants.test_case_name: canonical workflow hashing ignores object key order and whitespace

invariants.name: array semantics preserved
invariants.description: Changing array order changes workflow identity.
invariants.test_case_name: canonical workflow hashing preserves array semantics

invariants.name: streaming file hash
invariants.description: File hashes are calculated from stream chunks and equal the known SHA-256 digest.
invariants.test_case_name: streamed file hashing matches the known SHA-256 without reading the whole file

invariants.name: stable model hash ordering
invariants.description: Reordered input specs produce identical sorted model results and sequential start/completion events.
invariants.test_case_name: model hashing returns stable keys and sorted results

invariants.name: missing model failure
invariants.description: A missing required model rejects with its stable manifest-derived identity.
invariants.test_case_name: model hashing reports a missing required file with its manifest key

invariants.name: model root containment
invariants.description: Absolute and parent-traversal model paths are rejected before filesystem access.
invariants.test_case_name: model path resolution rejects absolute and parent traversal paths

invariants.name: model mutation detection
invariants.description: Size or modification-time drift during a streamed hash aborts collection instead of certifying mixed bytes.
invariants.test_case_name: model hashing rejects a file that changes while it is read

tasks.title: Add LTX model footprint and disk reservation preflight

signature_changes.note: Adds the documented decimal-gigabyte conversion constant.
Adds the required 100 GB LTX reservation constant.
Adds measured footprint and filesystem capacity evidence.
Adds a typed below-reservation failure carrying the measured result.
Adds the exact byte-threshold calculation.
Adds live aggregation of manifest-listed model files.
Adds filesystem measurement and reservation enforcement.

invariants.name: live footprint aggregation
invariants.description: The footprint equals the current sum of every explicitly listed regular model file.
invariants.test_case_name: preflight sums the live sizes of all manifest-listed model categories

invariants.name: reservation equality passes
invariants.description: Exactly 100,000,000,000 available bytes satisfies the 100 GB reservation.
invariants.test_case_name: preflight passes when available space equals the 100 GB reservation

invariants.name: below reservation fails
invariants.description: One byte below the required reservation throws with measured and required byte values.
invariants.test_case_name: preflight fails clearly one byte below the 100 GB reservation

invariants.name: available blocks are authoritative
invariants.description: Free space is calculated from filesystem blocks available to the process.
invariants.test_case_name: preflight uses filesystem available blocks rather than total blocks

invariants.name: regular model files only
invariants.description: A directory or other non-regular entry cannot contribute to model footprint.
invariants.test_case_name: preflight rejects a directory where a model file is required

tasks.title: Capture ComfyUI and custom-node Git provenance

signature_changes.note: Adds explicit tracked, non-Git, and unavailable custom-node evidence.
Adds the runtime and sorted custom-node revision result.
Adds shell-free repository HEAD resolution.
Adds strict base and tolerant custom-node Git collection.

invariants.name: base HEAD captured
invariants.description: A valid ComfyUI repository returns its exact verified HEAD object ID.
invariants.test_case_name: git provenance captures the exact ComfyUI HEAD

invariants.name: custom node ordering and classification
invariants.description: Immediate custom-node directories are sorted and non-Git directories remain explicit evidence.
invariants.test_case_name: git provenance sorts custom nodes and marks non-Git directories

invariants.name: missing custom nodes tolerated
invariants.description: A missing custom_nodes directory produces an empty list when the base repository is valid.
invariants.test_case_name: git provenance tolerates a missing custom_nodes directory

invariants.name: base repository required
invariants.description: Collection fails when the configured ComfyUI directory has no resolvable Git HEAD.
invariants.test_case_name: git provenance fails when the ComfyUI base is not a Git repository

invariants.name: shell-free path handling
invariants.description: Repository paths containing spaces or shell punctuation are passed as execFile arguments.
invariants.test_case_name: git commit lookup treats metacharacters in paths as data

tasks.title: Parse and validate certification profile manifests

signature_changes.note: Adds exact API node assertions for frozen workflow baselines.
Adds the validated in-memory certification profile shape.
Adds strict profile selection, validation, and contained workflow resolution.

invariants.name: contained workflow resolution
invariants.description: A selected workflow path resolves within its certification manifest directory.
invariants.test_case_name: manifest loading returns the selected profile with a contained workflow path

invariants.name: unique identities
invariants.description: Profile IDs and category-relative model identities cannot be duplicated.
invariants.test_case_name: manifest loading rejects duplicate profile and model identities

invariants.name: pinned attributed profile
invariants.description: Malformed hashes or missing source URI, revision, or license prevent profile loading.
invariants.test_case_name: manifest loading rejects malformed hashes and incomplete source provenance

invariants.name: manifest path containment
invariants.description: Absolute and parent-traversal workflow paths cannot escape the manifest directory.
invariants.test_case_name: manifest loading rejects workflow paths outside the manifest directory

invariants.name: closed categories and identity
invariants.description: Unknown model categories and unrecognized RenderProfile identities are rejected.
invariants.test_case_name: manifest loading rejects unknown model categories and invalid LTX identity literals

invariants.name: actionable profile selection
invariants.description: Unknown requested IDs fail with the available profile IDs.
invariants.test_case_name: manifest loading reports an unknown profile id with available ids

signature_changes.note: Adds a Pick of the existing RenderProfile fields populated by provenance collection.
Inspected as the stable source type for RenderProfileProvenance; the contract is deliberately unchanged.
Adds deterministic progress events for CLI human output.
Adds the machine-readable certification report shape.
Adds injectable dependency overrides for deterministic testing of report collection.
Adds fail-fast orchestration of preflight, Git, workflow, and model evidence.

invariants.name: preflight precedes large reads
invariants.description: Disk validation runs before workflow/model hashing and a failure stops all later calls.
invariants.test_case_name: collector runs preflight before hashing any large file

invariants.name: workflow drift fails before models
invariants.description: A canonical hash mismatch aborts before any model file is hashed.
invariants.test_case_name: collector rejects workflow hash drift before model hashing

invariants.name: LTX contract mapping
invariants.description: Stable model keys and the existing LTX identity, baseline, footprint, and reservation populate RenderProfile provenance fields.
invariants.test_case_name: collector emits stable model keys and LTX RenderProfile provenance fields

invariants.name: Git evidence preserved
invariants.description: Tracked and non-Git custom-node results remain visible in the report.
invariants.test_case_name: collector preserves ComfyUI and non-Git custom-node evidence

invariants.name: FLUX does not impersonate LTX
invariants.description: FLUX retains generic hashes but has null LTX-only RenderProfile provenance.
invariants.test_case_name: collector emits null RenderProfile provenance for FLUX without losing hashes

invariants.name: deterministic phase progress
invariants.description: Phase start/completion events and per-model detail follow the declared sequential order.
invariants.test_case_name: collector reports progress in deterministic phase order

tasks.title: Add the provenance CLI and package command

signature_changes.note: Adds the parsed CLI configuration shape.
Adds injectable manifest loader and provenance collector dependency overrides for CLI testing.
Adds strict parsing for help, ComfyUI path, profile, and manifest flags.
Adds injectable CLI execution with pipe-safe output and numeric status.

invariants.name: required and closed flags
invariants.description: Missing required flags, unknown flags, duplicate flags, and missing values fail before profile loading.
invariants.test_case_name: CLI requires comfyui-dir and profile and rejects unknown flags

invariants.name: help is side-effect free
invariants.description: Help prints usage without loading a manifest or collecting provenance.
invariants.test_case_name: CLI help has no provenance side effects

invariants.name: pipe-safe success output
invariants.description: Progress uses stderr and successful stdout receives exactly one JSON document.
invariants.test_case_name: CLI writes progress only to stderr and one JSON report to stdout

invariants.name: no partial failure report
invariants.description: A failed collection returns 1, writes an actionable stderr error, and writes no stdout JSON.
invariants.test_case_name: CLI returns failure without partial JSON when preflight or collection fails

invariants.name: configured runtime path
invariants.description: The selected profile and supplied ComfyUI directory are forwarded without a hard-coded home path.
invariants.test_case_name: CLI forwards the selected profile and configured ComfyUI path

invariants.name: package command wiring
invariants.description: The infrastructure package script invokes the exact provenance TypeScript entrypoint.
invariants.test_case_name: infrastructure provenance script exposes the TypeScript entrypoint

tasks.title: Add source-gated Gold Master workflows and provenance records

invariants.name: API-format pinned assets
invariants.description: Both workflows are API object maps and recompute to their manifest canonical hashes.
invariants.test_case_name: Gold Master workflows are API-format object maps with pinned canonical hashes

invariants.name: FLUX four-step baseline
invariants.description: The exact validated FLUX sampler assertion resolves to four steps.
invariants.test_case_name: FLUX Gold Master pins the validated four-step sampler node

invariants.name: LTX frozen baseline
invariants.description: Exact LTX API node assertions resolve to 720p, 97 frames, and eight steps.
invariants.test_case_name: LTX Gold Master pins 720p 97-frame eight-step baseline nodes

invariants.name: complete model identities
invariants.description: Each certification model has a unique supported category and exact relative path.
invariants.test_case_name: Gold Master profiles identify every referenced certification model file

invariants.name: immutable source evidence
invariants.description: Every profile records a real source URI, revision, license basis, and matching documentation without placeholders.
invariants.test_case_name: Gold Master provenance contains immutable source and license evidence

invariants.name: LTX operating envelope
invariants.description: The LTX profile retains its 100 GB minimum, DynamicVRAM runner, and existing RenderProfile identity.
invariants.test_case_name: LTX Gold Master enforces the 100 GB DynamicVRAM profile
